subject: PO metadata, invoicing rhythm & net-term tradeoffs – Panacea (follow-up)
messages:
From: Marta Silva <marta@panacealabs.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@panacealabs.com
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:08:12 -0700
Subject: Request: PO header requirements & billing cadence for Redwood proposal

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the proposal last week. Procurement has reviewed the commercial and we have two operational questions before we can route a PO:  

1) PO headers / metadata – we require the invoice to include PO_NUMBER, COST_CENTER, and PROJECT_CODE. Can Redwood accept these as top-level invoice fields and echo them back in remittance?

2) Billing cadence – Panacea prefers monthly invoices aligned to the calendar month. However our ERP team occasionally asks for weekly micro-invoices for specific pilots. Are you able to support both monthly and weekly invoice frequencies depending on the PO line item?

3) Net terms – standard for us is Net45. The commercial spoke about Net30; any flexibility to move to Net45? If not, can you quantify any early-payment discount if we move to Net15?

Finally, our PO will be a single purchase order that will reference three delivery locations/legal entities (Panacea Labs US, Panacea Labs EU, Panacea Labs APAC). We need to understand whether Redwood needs separate billing entities or if you can accept one PO that references multiple ship-to entities (ERP metadata on each invoice line).

I've attached our Panacea_PO_Template.xlsx for your finance team. Please confirm what fields you need and suggested alignment.

Thanks,
Marta Silva
Procurement Lead | Panacea Labs
procurement@panacealabs.com

Attachment: Panacea_PO_Template.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Silva <marta@panacealabs.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 10:45:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PO header requirements & billing cadence for Redwood proposal

Marta — thanks for the clear ask and the template. Quick answers and proposed next steps below.

- PO metadata: We can include PO_NUMBER, COST_CENTER, and PROJECT_CODE on every invoice header and (where supported) on per-line metadata. We’ll need the exact field names your ERP expects (case-sensitive) — the spreadsheet helps but can you confirm the header row names?

- Billing cadence: We support monthly as our default. We can also issue weekly micro-invoices for specific pilot lines but note that this increases our operational overhead. If you plan weekly for only one pilot entity, we can accommodate with a small per-invoice processing fee; if you expect weekly across the entire PO, we should lock in a cadence now.

- Net terms: We can accept Net45 for enterprise commitments of 12 months or more. Alternate: Net30 is standard on self-serve; if you pay Net15 we can provide a 2% early-pay discount. For Net45 on a 12-month committed spend, we could offer a 4% volume discount on top of list pricing.

Next steps: 1) Can you confirm which legal billing entity will accept invoices? 2) If you want Net45 + 4% volume discount, we’ll need the commitment length on the deal and to route to Finance for approval. 3) If you want weekly invoices for a pilot, flag which PO line(s) and we’ll scope the processing fee.

I’ll loop Vanessa and Ben for implementation details and to draft a short amendment for SOW / billing terms.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Redwood_PO_guidelines.pdf (pdf, 22KB)

Subject: Internal: Panacea PO mapping + Net45 ask – what do we need?

Vanessa / Ben — forwarding procurement’s template. They want: PO_NUMBER, COST_CENTER, PROJECT_CODE on invoice headers and the ability to have one PO reference three legal entities. Also requesting Net45 (they asked us whether we can accept it).

Questions:
- Can Finance accept a single PO referencing multiple ship-to/ ultimately-billed entities if we route invoice lines to the proper ledger codes? Any tax/AR implications?
- If we offer Net45 + 4% volume discount (12 month commitment), can Sales sign this or do we need Legal/Finance sign-off?
- For weekly micro-invoices, do we have a standard processing fee we can quote?

If you can reply quick I’ll push a formal note back to Procurement this afternoon.

Thanks,
Dylan

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 12:18:44 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Panacea PO mapping + Net45 ask – what do we need?

Folks — quick alignment from Finance:

- Single PO w/ multiple ship-to: We can accept it if the PO template provides a per-line COST_CENTER and PROJECT_CODE and each invoice line clearly maps to a Redwood billing entity (we’ll set up sub-ledger tags). We DO need Panacea to include the legal billing entity name for remittance on each invoice.

- Net45 / discounts: Finance can approve Net45 only for an annual committed contract >= $250k ARR equivalent. For Net45 + 4% volume discount we’ll need a signed commitment (12 months) and Legal to attach an amendment to the master services agreement. Sales should not promise the 4% without Legal sign-off.

- Weekly invoices: We can support weekly micro-invoices for pilots but charge $40 per invoice processing fee and require an invoice_batch_id in the PO metadata for reconciliation.

I’ve attached a CSV with the billing pattern options and header names we need to match to their ERP.

Vanessa Ortiz
Finance Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachment: billing_pattern_options.csv (csv, 3KB)

From: Marta Silva <marta@panacealabs.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@panacealabs.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:05:09 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: PO header requirements & billing cadence for Redwood proposal

Dylan — appreciate the rapid reply and Vanessa’s note. Panacea can accommodate the legal billing entity on each invoice line. A few clarifications and a counter-proposal:  

1) We can do the 12-month commitment if Redwood confirms the 4% volume discount and Net45 in writing. Our procurement/FP&A team requires the discount be applied to invoice-level net amounts (after any usage credits).

2) Weekly micro-invoices will only be used for a single pilot line (pilot: Project Kestrel) — we can accept the $40/invoice processing fee. We will include invoice_batch_id metadata on the PO for pilot lines.

3) For payment cadence, Panacea will accept Net45. Separately, we request a 7.5% first-year onboarding credit (one-time) to offset integration effort for the pilot. Is that something Redwood can consider as a one-time contra?

4) Attached is an example invoice CSV layout we’d like you to emulate. Please confirm Redwood can echo PO_NUMBER, COST_CENTER, PROJECT_CODE and invoice_batch_id fields.

If you can provide a short amendment text we can route to Legal for signature alongside the PO.

Thanks,
Marta

Attachment: panacea_invoice_sample.csv (csv, 2KB)

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Silva <marta@panacealabs.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, legal@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 16:32:07 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PO header requirements & billing cadence for Redwood proposal

Marta — great, thanks for the clarity. Short confirmation and next steps:  

- We confirm adding PO_NUMBER, COST_CENTER, PROJECT_CODE, and invoice_batch_id on invoices and per-line metadata where needed.
- Finance can approve Net45 + 4% volume discount on a 12-month committed spend (>= $250k ARR equivalent).
- We can support weekly micro-invoices for Project Kestrel at $40/invoice and will honor invoice_batch_id for reconciliation.
- Regarding the 7.5% onboarding credit: Sales is authorized to offer a one-time 5% onboarding credit. For the additional 2.5% we’ll need Legal/RevOps sign-off — I’ve CC’d Legal to route a short amendment.

Action items:
1) I’ll draft a two-line amendment (Net45 + 4% discount, billing metadata, weekly pilot fee) and share to legal this morning.
2) Marta — if Panacea confirms the 12-month term and expected ARR, I’ll escalate to Finance to lock the Net45 approval.
3) Vanessa — please prepare billing templates and reconciliation notes for Finance to accept the mixed cadence (monthly + weekly pilot).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Best,
Dylan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
